name: AI Harness Agent
description: Multi-agent task harness for Nicle IDE: coordinates Agent A (Coder) and Agent B (Reviewer) for any AI model
author: Nicle Core Team

commands.title: AI Harness: Run Reviewer Audit (Agent B)
commands.description: Audits current git diff for Rust/Svelte safety, memory bounds, and regressions

commands.title: AI Harness: Run Full Verification Pipeline (Agent C)
commands.description: Executes svelte-check, plugin schema validator, and review suite

commands.title: AI Harness: Dispatch Coder Agent (Agent A)
commands.description: Generates a standardized Agent A task envelope with PRD & rust-skills invariants

commands.title: AI Harness: Dispatch Reviewer Agent (Agent B)
commands.description: Generates a standardized Agent B review envelope for auditing diffs
